propositions: Phantom SYNC-dependent checks (orphaned, duplicates, stale) never execute because rebar never wrote SYNC events; these cells must be removed from the fsck output contract and all consumers.

Unknown event types must be detected using a checkout-free two-stage Git scan (git grep on refs/heads/tickets, then git show for residual candidates) to avoid false positives in comments or compiled state.

Store integrity must verify forward/reverse bindings agreement offline: confirmed forward entries require a non-empty Jira key and matching reverse entry; reverse entries must point to confirmed forward entries with matching keys.

Git operation failures (missing executable, missing ref, malformed output, grep exit >=2, read failure) must raise RebarError(returncode=2) and exit CLI with status 2; they cannot be reported as a clean audit.
Consistent forward/reverse bindings yield an empty store_integrity list; any inconsistency returns a finding object with a kind enum, local_id, and related keys, and makes CLI exit 1.
Unknown event types remain informational (do not change exit status); binding_drift remains informational; only store_integrity findings gate with exit 1.
